context.body: Then King David answered, “Call Bathsheba in to me.” She came into the king’s presence and stood before the king.

observations.body: David renews his oath, commands Solomon ride the royal mule to Gihon, Zadok and Nathan anoint him, the city rejoices, Adonijah’s feast collapses, and Solomon grants conditional mercy.
observations.label: David orders Solomon’s public anointing: textual observation

payload.posture: Read 1 Kings 1:28–53 as its own succession, retelling, and temple preparation David setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: The source places succession becomes public action and ends the rival feast inside this David setting without explaining every motive, transition, or later consequence.
